passages.context: The complete homily was read through John 6:28-40. Chrysostom follows the questions about works and signs, belief in the sent one, the correction from Moses to the Father, and Christ's identification as bread of life. The passage is reception, not proof that sacramental contact substitutes for faith and conversion.
